title.es: Sulfuro de níquel con lamas de serpentina

description.en: Pentlandite in a serpentinised ultramafic host. A desliming cyclone rejects MgO-rich serpentine fines before flotation, while fine pentlandite can be lost to the same stream.
description.es: Pentlandita en una roca ultramáfica serpentinizada. Un ciclón de deslamado rechaza finos de serpentina ricos en MgO antes de la flotación, mientras la pentlandita fina puede perderse en esa misma corriente.

question.en: What nickel recovery and MgO rejection does the desliming cut trade?
question.es: ¿Qué recuperación de níquel y rechazo de MgO intercambia el corte de deslamado?

provenance: authored scenario; parameters inside cited ranges; not plant-calibrated

sources.breakage: Moly-Cop Tools energy-specific selection (alpha0 0.0091 t/kWh, alpha1 0.651, alpha2 2.5, d_crit 6514 µm) and its documented alternative breakage set (beta0 0.4, beta1 0.65, beta2 4.02); methodology page 03.
sources.crusher: Whiten classification K1 0.5 to 0.95 CSS, K2 1.7 to 3.5 CSS, K3 about 2.3; methodology page 02.
sources.cyclone: Plitt geometry ratios typical of mineral-processing cyclones; sharpness and underflow density authored; methodology page 04.
sources.deslime: A size-selective desliming cyclone ahead of flotation rejects fine clay or serpentine with an authored cut, sharpness and underflow-solids target; the partition and water split use the same cyclone balance as the grinding classifier; methodology page 08.
sources.flotation: k from bubble surface area flux (Gorain et al. 1997), Savassi entrainment, perfect-mixer banks; floatability and widths authored within Trahar (1981) size behaviour; methodology page 05.
sources.collector: Saturating collector response with gangue saturating at a higher dose, an authored form whose direction the chalcopyrite/pyrite review supports (Castellón et al. 2022, Materials 15(19):6536, doi:10.3390/ma15196536); methodology page 05.
sources.water: Process-water capacity per tonne of ore (pumping and thickener capacity), authored 5% above each case's nominal requirement; it is the water constraint of the operating-point optimizer.
sources.kpi: Each nominal KPI range carries its own source in kpi_sources: a published value or range where one was found, labelled authored where none was; they are plausibility gates, not predictions.

recovery_pct.en: Authored: no published range was found for this case type.
recovery_pct.es: De autor: no se encontró un rango publicado para este tipo de caso.

concentrate_grade.en: About 20% Ni in serpentinised Mt Keith-type ore (review, Minerals 14(10):965, 2024, doi:10.3390/min14100965); the two-point band is authored.
concentrate_grade.es: Cerca de 20% Ni en mena serpentinizada tipo Mt Keith (revisión, Minerals 14(10):965, 2024, doi:10.3390/min14100965); la banda de dos puntos es de autor.

concentrate_MgO.en: About 10% MgO at a concentrate Fe:MgO of 2.9 at Mt Keith (Senior et al. 2006, Int. J. Miner. Process.; UNVERIFIED against the full text). This authored desliming scenario uses a lower floor because the cyclone rejects MgO-rich slimes.
concentrate_MgO.es: Cerca de 10% MgO con una razón Fe:MgO del concentrado de 2,9 en Mt Keith (Senior et al. 2006, Int. J. Miner. Process.; NO VERIFICADO contra el texto completo). Este escenario de deslamado de autor usa un piso menor porque el ciclón descarta lamas ricas en MgO.
